package service

import (
	"cmp"
	"context"
	"math"
	"slices"

	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/timestamppb"

	pb "github.com/acme/inventory/gen/acme/inventory/v1"
)

const scanPage = 500

// eachProduct calls fn for every stored product, in id order.
func (s *Server) eachProduct(ctx context.Context, fn func(*pb.Product)) error {
	after := ""
	for {
		page, err := s.store.ListProducts(ctx, after, scanPage)
		if err != nil {
			return s.toStatus(ctx, err)
		}
		for _, p := range page {
			fn(p)
		}
		if len(page) < scanPage {
			return nil
		}
		after = page[len(page)-1].GetId()
	}
}

// AdjustStock changes the stock of the product with the given sku by delta.
func (s *Server) AdjustStock(ctx context.Context, req *pb.AdjustStockRequest) (*pb.AdjustStockResponse, error) {
	if req.GetSku() == "" {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "sku: is required")
	}
	var id string
	if err := s.eachProduct(ctx, func(p *pb.Product) {
		if p.GetSku() == req.GetSku() {
			id = p.GetId()
		}
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if id == "" {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "no product with sku %q", req.GetSku())
	}
	updated, err := s.store.UpdateProduct(ctx, id, func(p *pb.Product) error {
		next := int64(p.GetStock()) + int64(req.GetDelta())
		if next < 0 {
			return status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "stock would drop to %d", next)
		}
		if next > math.MaxInt32 {
			return status.Error(codes.OutOfRange, "stock would overflow")
		}
		p.Stock = int32(next)
		p.UpdateTime = timestamppb.New(s.now())
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, s.toStatus(ctx, err)
	}
	return &pb.AdjustStockResponse{Product: updated}, nil
}

// LowStockReport returns active products with stock below threshold, lowest first.
func (s *Server) LowStockReport(ctx context.Context, req *pb.LowStockReportRequest) (*pb.LowStockReportResponse, error) {
	if req.GetThreshold() <= 0 {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "threshold: must be positive")
	}
	var low []*pb.Product
	if err := s.eachProduct(ctx, func(p *pb.Product) {
		if p.GetActive() && p.GetStock() < req.GetThreshold() {
			low = append(low, p)
		}
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	slices.SortStableFunc(low, func(a, b *pb.Product) int { return cmp.Compare(a.GetStock(), b.GetStock()) })
	return &pb.LowStockReportResponse{Products: low}, nil
}
